hero.title: The Frankencoin|Association
hero.subtitle: The independent Swiss association behind ZCHF, the largest Swiss franc stablecoin.

why.title: Why the Swiss franc
why.subtitle: Switzerland is built to keep its money safe and stable. That is the asset.

items.title: Debt brake.
items.description: Written into the constitution and voted by the people. Spending follows revenue.

items.title: AAA.
items.description: Top rating from all three major agencies.

items.title: Independent central bank.
items.description: Its mandate is price stability, not elections.

items.title: Neutral since 1815.
items.description: When the world is uncertain, capital comes here.

why.note: Since 1971 the dollar has lost about 80% of its value against the franc. Yet the franc is around 1% of world payments and only 0.015% of stablecoins. The Swiss Bankers Association puts the potential for CHF stablecoins at CHF 2.8–3.0bn at today's market size.

items.label: Listed and live, with more integrations on the way

membership.title: What the Association does
membership.subtitle: The Frankencoin Association promotes a stable Swiss franc and a digital Swiss economy, at home and globally. Membership is by invitation.

items.title: Promoting a stable franc and a digital Swiss economy, globally.
items.description: We make the case for the Swiss franc and the digital Swiss economy with regulators, banks, exchanges and media around the world, so that the franc keeps its role as a safe haven on-chain.

items.title: Education with government and institutions.
items.description: Briefings and workshops with authorities, parliament, banks and universities on how stablecoins work, what makes Frankencoin different and what sound regulation looks like.

items.title: Members' meeting in Zug.
items.description: Once a year, with the board and the advisory board: the state of the protocol, the agenda ahead and the people behind it.

items.title: Private events and meetings.
items.description: In the most sought-after rooms at the year's key global gatherings, with the association's network.

items.title: Helping members in the Swiss market.
items.description: Curated, vetted introductions to leading businesses, institutions and regulatory expertise, with hands-on help turning them into lasting relationships.

contact.text: In uncertain times, the world runs to the Swiss franc. Own its digital future.
